<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="hero1" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#9747FF"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#4658E0"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="hero2" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#0BAEAF"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#110053"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="3" stdDeviation="5" flood-color="#DCDCDC" flood-opacity=".8"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F3F2F7"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <g fill="#110053">
    <text x="20" y="24" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="13" font-weight="700">9:41</text>
    <rect x="333" y="15" width="3" height="9" rx="1" fill="#110053"/>
    <rect x="338" y="12" width="3" height="12" rx="1" fill="#110053"/>
    <rect x="343" y="9" width="3" height="15" rx="1" fill="#110053"/>
    <circle cx="356" cy="18" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="360" y1="22" x2="363" y2="25" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="369" y="11" width="16" height="13" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="371" y="13" width="11" height="9" rx="2" fill="#0BAEAF"/>
    <rect x="385" y="15" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#110053"/>
  </g>

  <!-- header -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="34" width="390" height="68" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polyline points="27,68 19,76 27,84" fill="none" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

    <circle cx="353" cy="76" r="18" fill="#EFEDFA"/>
    <circle cx="353" cy="71" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#1B0188" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <ellipse cx="353" cy="81" rx="8" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#1B0188" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- segmented tabs -->
  <g>
    <rect x="14" y="116" width="362" height="43" rx="7" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D1D1D2"/>
    <rect x="16" y="118" width="86" height="39" rx="6" fill="#EFEDFA"/>
    <line x1="102" y1="122" x2="102" y2="153" stroke="#D1D1D2"/>
    <line x1="193" y1="122" x2="193" y2="153" stroke="#D1D1D2"/>
    <line x1="284" y1="122" x2="284" y2="153" stroke="#D1D1D2"/>
    <text x="59" y="143" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#1B0188">Paquetes</text>
    <text x="147" y="143" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#5C5C5C">Vuelos</text>
    <text x="238" y="143" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#5C5C5C">Hoteles</text>
    <text x="330" y="143" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#5C5C5C">Autos</text>
  </g>

  <text x="18" y="190" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="19" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Escapadas para ti</text>
  <text x="372" y="190" text-anchor="end" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#EA104C">Ver todo</text>

  <!-- card 1 shadow and card -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="14" y="204" width="362" height="190" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="14" y="204" width="362" height="112" rx="14" fill="url(#hero1)"/>
    <circle cx="304" cy="231" r="17" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".22"/>
    <circle cx="300" cy="226" r="5" fill="#FFF9E6"/>
    <polygon points="78,284 132,235 157,263 185,247 249,301" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".65"/>
    <polygon points="36,303 92,256 126,282 158,267 211,303" fill="#EFEDFA" opacity=".7"/>
    <circle cx="76" cy="236" r="9" fill="#FFF9E6"/>
    <rect x="28" y="220" width="92" height="23" rx="12" fill="#EA104C"/>
    <text x="74" y="236" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">OFERTA ESPECIAL</text>
    <text x="29" y="344" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Cartagena, Colombia</text>
    <text x="29" y="364" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Vuelo + hotel · 4 noches</text>
    <text x="29" y="383" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#110053">Desde</text>
    <text x="76" y="384" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#1B0188">$689</text>
    <text x="119" y="383" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">por persona</text>
    <rect x="291" y="351" width="69" height="29" rx="7" fill="#EA104C"/>
    <text x="325" y="370" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Ver oferta</text>
  </g>

  <text x="18" y="430" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="19" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Destinos destacados</text>

  <!-- card 2 -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="14" y="444" width="174" height="176" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="14" y="444" width="174" height="92" rx="14" fill="url(#hero2)"/>
    <circle cx="145" cy="463" r="8" fill="#FFF9E6"/>
    <polygon points="20,526 58,483 82,507 111,489 174,530" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".5"/>
    <rect x="27" y="551" width="54" height="21" rx="10" fill="#EFEDFA"/>
    <text x="54" y="565" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#1B0188">PLAYA</text>
    <text x="27" y="592" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Cancún</text>
    <text x="27" y="609" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12" fill="#5C5C5C">Desde $799</text>
  </g>

  <!-- card 3 -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="202" y="444" width="174" height="176" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="202" y="444" width="174" height="92" rx="14" fill="#9747FF"/>
    <circle cx="332" cy="465" r="9" fill="#FFF9E6"/>
    <polygon points="208,527 242,492 266,508 297,475 369,528" fill="#EFEDFA" opacity=".72"/>

    <text x="248" y="565" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#1B0188">AVENTURA</text>
    <text x="215" y="592" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Buenos Aires</text>
    <text x="215" y="609" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12" fill="#5C5C5C">Desde $549</text>
  </g>

  <!-- service strip -->
  <g>
    <text x="18" y="657" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">También puedes reservar</text>
    <rect x="14" y="671" width="362" height="53" rx="7" fill="#EFEDFA"/>
    <circle cx="44" cy="697" r="17" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="38" y="691" width="12" height="10" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#1B0188" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="38" y1="695" x2="50" y2="695" stroke="#1B0188" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="72" y="695" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Traslados y actividades</text>
    <text x="72" y="712" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="11" fill="#5C5C5C">Completa tu viaje fácilmente</text>
    <polyline points="350,693 356,698 350,703" fill="none" stroke="#EA104C" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="742" width="390" height="102" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="742" x2="390" y2="742" stroke="#E0E0E2"/>
    <g transform="translate(38 758)">
      <polygon points="0,10 12,0 24,10" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="2"/>
      <rect x="5" y="9" width="14" height="12" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="12" y="43" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#5C5C5C">Inicio</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(126 758)">
      <circle cx="11" cy="10" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#EA104C" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="17" y1="16" x2="23" y2="22" stroke="#EA104C" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="11" y="43" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#EA104C">Buscar</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(214 758)">
      <rect x="2" y="3" width="20" height="16" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="2"/>
      <polyline points="7,3 7,0 17,0 17,3" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="12" y="43" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#5C5C5C">Viajes</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(306 758)">
      <circle cx="12" cy="7" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="2"/>
      <ellipse cx="12" cy="18" rx="9" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="12" y="43" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#5C5C5C">Cuenta</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
